# Copilot instructions

The full project guide is in `AGENTS.md` at the repository root. Read it first.

Key rules: `main` is the live GitHub Pages site (work on branches, open PRs); the site is in Russian for a small party, with skill, item and place names kept in English as in the game; README, code and commits in English; page texts live in `content/*.json`; `data/` and `build/` are generated by `tools/build_all.sh`, do not hand-edit; no secrets and no game files in the repo.
